Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking time today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the procurement milestones we discussed (Ariba/Coupa vendor setup, completed vendor forms, W-9 + banking info, and procurement sign-off). The key milestones, owners, and target dates are in the spreadsheet.

Quick summary of next steps I captured: 
- Palmetto: return completed vendor form + W-9 (we can accept scanned PDF) — target 11/25
- Redwood: create Ariba/Coupa vendor record and share vendor ID — target 11/27
- Palmetto Procurement: confirm payment terms & banking details (ACH) — target 11/29
- Joint: procurement close & PO issuance — target 12/03

Dependencies we flagged: Palmetto needs vendor tax ID + banking ACH mockup; Redwood will need the signed SOW before we accept a PO in Ariba/Coupa.

I attached the vendor form we typically use and a blank W-9 template. If you prefer, we can take the vendor form over a quick 15-min call to speed things up.

Looping in Marissa (CS) to coordinate onboarding once procurement is complete, and Karthik to help with any technical fields on the vendor form.

Would you like us to generate a DocuSign packet with the SOW + vendor form once you confirm?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Sean —

Appreciate the summary and the draft MAP. A couple of quick questions from procurement as they reviewed the vendor form: 
1) Our Ariba team prefers vendor setup via an emailed CSV import — can your team accept that, or do we need to complete the online supplier portal?
2) On the banking details: we can provide ACH, but procurement needs a W-9 and a voided check. Is a bank letter acceptable if we redact account numbers?

We should be able to return the completed vendor form + W-9 by 11/25 if all fields are clear. For the SOW, Tom will confirm internal budget sign-off by 11/30 — I’ll keep you posted.

Also, can you confirm the exact SOW filename you’ll be sending for DocuSign so our legal team can reference it in the PO?

Thanks —

> 
> Appreciate the summary and the draft MAP. A couple of quick questions from procurement as they reviewed the vendor form: 
> 1) Our Ariba team prefers vendor setup via an emailed CSV import — can your team accept that, or do we need to complete the online supplier portal?
> 2) On the banking details: we can provide ACH, but procurement needs a W-9 and a voided check. Is a bank letter acceptable if we redact account numbers?
> 
> We should be able to return the completed vendor form + W-9 by 11/25 if all fields are clear. For the SOW, Tom will confirm internal budget sign-off by 11/30 — I’ll keep you posted.

Thanks for the quick review — answers below: 
- Ariba/CSV: We can accept an emailed CSV for initial ingestion into our finance team's Ariba/Coupa workflow. Please include column headers: vendor_name, tax_id, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, zip, country, remit_to_email, primary_contact. If you send CSV, cc finance@redwood.com and we’ll pick it up.
- Banking verification: a bank letter with the account holder name + routing number is acceptable for initial setup if you redact the full account number. For final payment setup our finance team will need either a voided check or an ACH authorization form with full account details; that can be provided to Redwood Finance over our secure upload link.

SOW filename: Redwood_SOW_Palmetto_ProdTrial_v1.pdf — we will prepare a DocuSign packet once you confirm the vendor form timeline.

Marissa — can you confirm the secure upload link for banking docs and the finance contact for CSV ingestion?
Karthik — FYI there are a couple of technical fields on the vendor form that Palmetto asked us to clarify (system integrator checkbox, SOC2 scope) — can you review and advise whether we should provide default values or have Palmetto fill them in?

Best,
Sean

Thanks — I’m Marissa on the Customer Success team and I’ll own the onboarding coordination once procurement is complete. Quick answers:

- Finance contact for CSV ingestion: finance@redwood.com (cc’d in this thread). When you send the CSV please include a brief note with the expected PO number and desired payment terms.
- For the vendor form technical fields: Karthik, if you can add short clarifying comments on the spreadsheet (column comments), that will likely speed return from Palmetto.
